Assistant A correctly calculates the probability by enumerating all 36 equally likely outcomes when rolling two dice and counting the 30 outcomes where the sum is at least 3, yielding a probability of 30/36 = 5/6 ≈ 83.3%. Assistant B incorrectly states the probability is 1/3 (33.3%) based on a flawed reasoning that does not account for the actual distribution of sums. Therefore, Assistant A provides the accurate and well-explained answer.

[[A]]
